tasks.short: Remove and replace tank car dome caps, or direct other workers in their removal and replacement.

steps.what: Remove the dome cap from the tank car
replace the cap after the removal is finished
direct other workers in their part of the job
Watch the replacement until the cap seats

tasks.design: She takes the dome cap off and puts it back, or she directs another worker through that same removal and replacement. She stays until the cap seats. No separate cap log is part of this task, so no second entry is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cap is on the tank car. A damaged thread or a missed seat can harm people, and another worker's hands may be on the hatch.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing here removes the cap work. An outbound order record is a different task and is not this step.
tasks.still_hard: A damaged thread, a cap that will not seat, and a coworker who is not at the hatch.
tasks.human_edge: She feels whether the cap is seated, and she stops a coworker who is on the wrong hatch.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still removes and replaces the cap, or directs that work, and she still checks the seat.

reach.task: Turn the dome cap on a hatch while she is on the next car
reach.learn: Which hatch is open so two people do not work the same cap

evidence.claim: Removing and replacing a tank car dome cap, or directing that work and watching the seat, is physical and stays with the loader.
A cap left loose can harm people, and that seat stays her responsibility.

assumptions: She removes and replaces the cap, or directs that work, and she checks the seat. That time stays.
No separate cap log is part of this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often she directs another worker instead of turning the cap herself.
research_questions: On what share of cars does a second person turn the cap while she directs?

already_counted.description: She still removes the cap, replaces it or directs that work, and watches the seat.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for the cap. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still does the cap work. A hatch another crew already closed is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform general warehouse activities, opening containers, filling orders, taking inventory, and weighing materials.

steps.what: Perform general warehouse activities at the dock
opening containers and crates before the goods move
filling warehouse orders by assisting the crew
taking inventory and weighing and checking materials

tasks.design: She opens containers and crates, fills warehouse orders, helps with the inventory, and weighs and checks the materials. That floor work stays hers. This task does not name a second tally of the order, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The container, the crate, and the scale are on the floor. The weight and the count are what she sees in front of her.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing here removes the opening, the fill, or the weighing. An outbound order record kept by a scan is a stocker's task, not this one.
tasks.still_hard: A crate that will not open, a short count in the bay, and a weight that does not match the order.
tasks.human_edge: She sees a damaged sack and a figure that does not match, and she does not pass that load.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still opens, fills, takes inventory, and weighs what she checks.

reach.task: Count a bay while she weighs the next pallet
reach.learn: Which pallet is already weighed so she does not weigh it twice

evidence.claim: Opening containers, filling warehouse orders, helping with inventory, and weighing and checking materials stay on the floor with the loader.
A wrong weight or a short count that she accepts stays her responsibility.

assumptions: She opens, fills, weighs and checks. That floor time stays.
No second tally of the order is named in this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often a clerk has already weighed the pallet before she reaches it.
research_questions: Which weights does she take herself, and which are already on the load before she checks?

already_counted.description: She still opens containers, fills orders, helps with inventory, and weighs and checks.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for the floor work. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still does the floor work. A weight a clerk already took is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Dome caps and warehouse floor work stay the week. She gains no right to leave a hatch open or to accept a weight she did not check.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a dome cap thread is damaged and do not force the seat.
Direct a coworker to the hatch that is actually open.
Say when a weighed figure does not match the order.
role.ambitious_version: She still climbs the tank car to remove and replace dome caps, or stands where she can direct that work, and she still opens containers, fills orders, and weighs what she checks. No remote cap change.

job.title: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
